ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 75% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels in the central lobe regions versus 25% low-intensity black pixels along the margins and linear markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields across both lobes; thick black pigmented borders along the trailing edges; multiple black linear streaks (rakes) radiating diagonally from the central notch toward the outer margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 48 degrees and significant penetration depth toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary featuring high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the inner lobes, transitioning to high-amplitude jagged protrusions and deep indentations at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature following the trailing edge from the notch to the mid-lobe, sweeping sharply upward to form pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark, roughly circular pixel groups situated at the extreme distal points of both lobes, indicative of previous barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of unaligned, high-contrast dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral fields, particularly prominent on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) across the visible ventral surface; irregular, ragged tissue loss visible at the distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly concentrated dark pigmentation focal point located at the base of the median notch where the two lobes converge.
